definitions.explanation: One's social standing, outward dignity, or reputation in the eyes of others. Similar to 'face' in the social sense.

examples.japanese: {体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
{体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つける→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧ようなことはしたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to do anything that would damage my reputation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にして→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}えなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't tell the truth because I was worried about the company's reputation.

notes:
{体面|たいめん} refers to one's outward dignity or social reputation — similar to the concept of 'face' in social contexts. Somewhat literary and formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain one's dignity
- {体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つける→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧: to damage one's reputation
- {体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繕|つくろ}う→繕う：11066_tsukurou⟧: to keep up appearances
- {体面|たいめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧: to worry about appearances

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧ (meeting face to face), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面子|めんつ}→面子：14617_mentsu⟧: face, pride (more colloquial)
- ⟦{体裁|ていさい}→体裁：09154_teisai⟧: outward appearances (more everyday)
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧: honor, reputation (broader scope)
